profile_text.body:
Coursera is an online learning platform that offers courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees from universities and companies including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. The company describes its offerings as providing job-ready skills and verifiable credentials. It also offers Coursera Plus, an annual subscription with unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The company's site highlights AI-related content, including generative AI courses, the AI Essentials Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Machine Learning Specialization, and the Deep Learning Specialization. It lists artificial intelligence as a browse area and presents programs such as the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate and the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate as pathways into technical roles.

Coursera is a for-profit public company trading as COUR, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, USA. Its SEC CIK is 0001651562. The company has 281 California law exposure entries.
